mapper.select: select count(1) as totalCount, count(distinct r.teacher_id) as teacherCount, count(distinct r.course_id) as courseCount, count(distinct r.student_id) as studentCount, coalesce(round(avg(),2),0) as avgScore, coalesce(round(max(),2),0) as maxScore, coalesce(round(min(),2),0) as minScore, coalesce(round(sum(case when >= 85 then 1 else 0 end)/count(1)*100,2),0) as satisfactionRate from aem_evaluation_result r left join aem_evaluation_questionnaire q on r.questionnaire_id = q.questionnaire_id where

select sum(case when >= 90 then 1 else 0 end) as excellentCount, sum(case when >= 80 and < 90 then 1 else 0 end) as goodCount, sum(case when >= 70 and < 80 then 1 else 0 end) as mediumCount, sum(case when >= 60 and < 70 then 1 else 0 end) as passCount, sum(case when < 60 then 1 else 0 end) as needsCount from aem_evaluation_result r left join aem_evaluation_questionnaire q on r.questionnaire_id = q.questionnaire_id where

select r.course_id as courseId, c.course_name as courseName, c.credit as credit, count(1) as totalCount, coalesce(round(avg(),2),0) as avgScore, coalesce(round(max(),2),0) as maxScore, coalesce(round(min(),2),0) as minScore, coalesce(round(sum(case when >= 85 then 1 else 0 end)/count(1)*100,2),0) as satisfactionRate from aem_evaluation_result r left join aem_evaluation_questionnaire q on r.questionnaire_id = q.questionnaire_id left join tpm_course_library c on c.course_id = r.course_id where group by r.course_id, c.course_name, c.credit order by avgScore desc

select r.teacher_id as teacherId, t.teacher_name as teacherName, t.teacher_code as teacherCode, count(distinct r.course_id) as courseCount, count(1) as totalCount, coalesce(round(avg(),2),0) as avgScore, coalesce(round(sum(case when >= 85 then 1 else 0 end)/count(1)*100,2),0) as satisfactionRate from aem_evaluation_result r left join aem_evaluation_questionnaire q on r.questionnaire_id = q.questionnaire_id left join brm_teacher t on t.teacher_id = r.teacher_id where group by r.teacher_id, t.teacher_name, t.teacher_code order by avgScore desc

select r.course_id as courseId, c.course_name as courseName, sem.semester_name as semesterName, count(1) as totalCount, coalesce(round(avg(),2),0) as avgScore, coalesce(round(max(),2),0) as maxScore, coalesce(round(min(),2),0) as minScore, coalesce(round(sum(case when >= 85 then 1 else 0 end)/count(1)*100,2),0) as satisfactionRate from aem_evaluation_result r left join aem_evaluation_questionnaire q on r.questionnaire_id = q.questionnaire_id left join tpm_course_library c on c.course_id = r.course_id left join brm_semester sem on sem.semester_id = q.semester_id where r.status = '0' and r.total_score is not null and r.teacher_id = #{teacherId} group by r.course_id, c.course_name, sem.semester_name order by avgScore desc

select sum(case when >= 90 then 1 else 0 end) as excellentCount, sum(case when >= 80 and < 90 then 1 else 0 end) as goodCount, sum(case when >= 70 and < 80 then 1 else 0 end) as mediumCount, sum(case when >= 60 and < 70 then 1 else 0 end) as passCount, sum(case when < 60 then 1 else 0 end) as needsCount from aem_evaluation_result r left join aem_evaluation_questionnaire q on r.questionnaire_id = q.questionnaire_id where r.status = '0' and r.total_score is not null and r.teacher_id = #{teacherId}

select count(1) as totalCount, count(distinct r.course_id) as courseCount, count(distinct r.student_id) as studentCount, coalesce(round(avg(),2),0) as avgScore, coalesce(round(sum(case when >= 85 then 1 else 0 end)/count(1)*100,2),0) as satisfactionRate from aem_evaluation_result r left join aem_evaluation_questionnaire q on r.questionnaire_id = q.questionnaire_id where r.status = '0' and r.total_score is not null and r.teacher_id = #{teacherId}
